title: Theatre of Dreams
subtitle: The illustrated story of Manchester United
version_note: The story so far, up to the middle of October 2026.
creator: Touchline
rights: An unofficial fan book. Not made, approved or endorsed by Manchester United. Photographs are credited at the back of the book.
title_notes: An unofficial fan book. It isn't made, approved or endorsed by Manchester United.
Every score, date and quote has been checked. The opinions are a United fan's, and we're not shy about them.
description: The story of Manchester United, from Ronaldo and Rooney to Ferguson's Treble, the Busby Babes, Munich and the Holy Trinity, and the war with City and Liverpool. With Word Watch boxes, myth-busters and a quiz.
glossary_blurb: Every Word Watch word in this book, from A to Z. The stars tell you how tricky each one is: ★ is a warm-up, ★★★ is a proper challenge. Try using three of them this week, and see if anyone notices.

chapters.title: The Greatest Hits
chapters.dek: One was a skinny winger from Madeira. The other was a stocky teenager from Liverpool. Together, they were the most dangerous partnership in football.

chapters.title: On the Brink
chapters.dek: Three years in, no trophies, and a banner in the crowd telling him to go. How Alex Ferguson survived.

chapters.title: Twenty-Six Years
chapters.dek: A night in Rotterdam, a phone call from Leeds, a Frenchman with his collar up, and two headers from a centre-back.

chapters.title: Kids and a King
chapters.dek: "You can't win anything with kids," said the man on the telly. The kids had other ideas.

chapters.title: Football, Bloody Hell
chapters.dek: Three trophies in eleven days, a wonder goal, the bravest captain, and the most famous three minutes in the club's history.

chapters.title: Railwaymen to Red Devils
chapters.dek: Before Ferguson, before Busby, before red shirts, there was a team of railway workers in green and gold. And they were nearly bankrupt.

chapters.title: The Babes and Munich
chapters.toc: Busby's Babes and the 1958 air disaster
chapters.dek: The greatest young team England had ever seen, and the day the club nearly died with them.

chapters.title: The Holy Trinity
chapters.toc: Best, Law, Charlton, and the long wait, 1958–1986
chapters.dek: Ten years after Munich, Matt Busby finally lifted the European Cup. Then came the hard years.

chapters.title: Moscow and Number Twenty
chapters.kicker: Part Four: Glory, Goodbye and Now
chapters.toc: Champions of Europe, champions of England, 2008–2013
chapters.dek: Rain in Moscow, a slip on the spot, the perch, and the day Sir Alex Ferguson said goodbye.

chapters.title: After Fergie
chapters.kicker: Part Four: Glory, Goodbye and Now
chapters.toc: Seven managers and the road back, 2013–2026
chapters.dek: Following the greatest manager of all time turned out to be the hardest job in football. Here's how United found their way back.

chapters.title: Noisy Neighbours
chapters.dek: A century in United's shadow, a mountain of money, and 114 broken rules. The case against Manchester City.

chapters.title: This Means War
chapters.toc: Liverpool, Leeds, and the Records Room
chapters.dek: The fiercest rivalry in English football, a grudge older than both clubs, and the numbers that settle every argument.

chapters.title: The Theatre of Dreams Quiz
chapters.label: Back of the book
chapters.dek: Twenty questions on the whole story, including a Word Watch round.
